answer: Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the shale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the hollow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
